criteria.asr_words: Correct clean/mixed phrase, no invented dialogue on absent-speech controls.
criteria.asr_timing: Finite ordered word intervals within clip; zero/missing offsets are not timing success.
criteria.sound_stage: Audio-grounded events separate from dialogue; strict dog recognition on controlled bursts; no effects on digital silence.
criteria.rendering: One ledger, stable event IDs and speech, three detail levels, no invented events/attributes/times.
criteria.no_speech_vs_no_sound: Empty ASR transcript never establishes acoustic silence.

budget.stop: Stop at auth/access failure for the affected stage or three consecutive capacity errors; no full-film run.

stages: Omni non-speech observations with own ASR as uncertain context
Evidence-labelled ledger and three-level draft rendering
Validate and retain failed candidates separately
raw_zero_asr: Diagnostic request deliberately tests all-zero input. A production preprocessor can bypass exact zeros; raw and wrapped behavior must be reported separately.
limits: Known synthetic/ESC-10 controls, not a generalization benchmark.
BBB window has no independent listening annotation; do not claim movie accuracy.
ASR output is generated from media, not fetched subtitle input; it may itself hallucinate.
Renderer cannot correct ungrounded observations. Unresolved sound timing cannot become invented subtitles.
All artifacts remain drafts outside playback; existing failed sound gate stays failed.
